_meta.indication: In combination with fluoropyrimidine- and platinum-containing chemotherapy, for first-line treatment of adults with locally advanced unresectable or metastatic HER2-negative gastric or gastroesophageal junction (GEJ) adenocarcinoma whose tumors are CLDN18.2 positive as determined by an FDA-approved test.

pivotal_trials.design: Double-blind, placebo-controlled, multiregional, randomized trial of zolbetuximab-clzb plus mFOLFOX6 vs placebo plus mFOLFOX6.
pivotal_trials.population: Previously untreated unresectable or metastatic HER2-negative, CLDN18.2-positive gastric or GEJ adenocarcinoma (CLDN18.2 positive = ≥75% of tumor cells with moderate to strong membranous CLDN18 staining).
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Primary endpoint: progression-free survival (PFS); key secondary endpoint OS.
pivotal_trials.result: PFS HR 0.75 (95% CI 0.598, 0.942; 1-sided p=0.0066), median PFS 10.6 vs 8.7 months; OS HR 0.75 (95% CI 0.601, 0.936; 1-sided p=0.0053), median OS 18.2 vs 15.5 months.

pivotal_trials.design: Double-blind, placebo-controlled, multiregional, randomized (1:1) trial of zolbetuximab-clzb plus CAPOX vs placebo plus CAPOX.
pivotal_trials.population: Previously untreated unresectable or metastatic HER2-negative, CLDN18.2-positive gastric or GEJ adenocarcinoma; eligibility generally similar to SPOTLIGHT.
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Primary endpoint: PFS per RECIST v1.1 as assessed by IRC; key secondary endpoints OS and TTCDC.
pivotal_trials.result: PFS HR 0.687 (95% CI 0.544, 0.866; 1-sided p=0.0007), median PFS 8.2 vs 6.8 months; OS HR 0.77 (95% CI 0.615, 0.965; 1-sided p=0.0118), median OS 14.4 vs 12.2 months.

key_safety: Most common adverse reactions (≥15%): nausea, vomiting, fatigue, decreased appetite, diarrhea, peripheral sensory neuropathy, abdominal pain, constipation, decreased weight, hypersensitivity reactions, pyrexia. More nausea (76%) and vomiting (67%) with zolbetuximab-clzb vs placebo (56% nausea, 33% vomiting). Serious adverse reactions in 45% of SPOTLIGHT patients; discontinuation due to AE in 20%.
target_moa: Chimeric (mouse/human) IgG1 monoclonal antibody that binds claudin-18 isoform 2 (CLDN18.2) and depletes CLDN18.2-positive cells via ADCC and CDC.
companion_dx_detail: VENTANA CLDN18 (43-14A) RxDx Assay (IHC) used to identify CLDN18.2-positive tumors (≥75% of tumor cells with moderate to strong membranous CLDN18 staining).
